title: US bond market early close 2:00 p.m. ET ahead of the observed Independence Day — the only 2027 SIFMA early close this calendar does not track
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed first-hand by the sifma-bond-market-closure-2027-11-11 initial research. The 2027 tab lives in the page's RSC payload rather than its plain HTML, so 119 holiday/date/note triples were decoded in order; card 75, inside the run of U.S. 2027 cards, reads exactly 'U.S. Independence Day' / 'Monday, July 5, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, July 2, 2027'. That is the same card shape the three sifma-bond-early-close entries already on this calendar were filed from (2026-12-31, 2027-03-25, 2027-05-28), and the note names both the date and the 2:00 p.m. ET cutoff verbatim. Filed estimate on the standard three counts for this id class: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a trade association's recommended schedule, a discovering lane may not self-confirm an in-sweep find, and SIFMA's schedule is a recommendation rather than a binding halt. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: HONEST SCOPE NOTE, STATED FIRST: 2027-07-02 is D-132 from the proposing event and therefore far OUTSIDE its +/-5-day corridor. It is proposed anyway on the same two grounds the proposal that created the proposer used at D-14: it was read first-hand off the identical SIFMA panel fetch the proposing event's own source rests on, and it is a documented hole in an id class this calendar already carries four times. Nothing in the proposing event's stance depends on it. WHY IT IS A HOLE: the proposing session diffed every 2027 US SIFMA card against the tracked calendar (canonical files and proposals together). Fourteen of the sixteen 2027 dates are tracked; exactly two are not, and this is one — the other is the observed Independence Day full closure itself, proposed separately as independence-day-market-closure-2027-07-05.from-sifma-bond-market-closure-2027-11-11.json. Every other 2027 SIFMA early close has an entry (sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 for Good Friday, -2027-05-28 for Memorial Day, and proposals for 2027-11-26 and 2027-12-23), which is what makes this one's absence an omission rather than a policy. HONEST LIMITS. (1) EventKind has no market-structure member, so this follows every sibling in filing 'rates'. (2) NYSE equity hours on 2027-07-02 are NOT asserted here: the NYSE grid fetched the same session lists 'Monday, July 5 (Independence Day observed)' as the 2027 Independence Day holiday and says nothing about a Friday 2027-07-02 equity early close, and whether NYSE also runs a 1:00 p.m. ET half session that day was not established. The whole cross-asset read is therefore left to whoever takes the entry. (3) CME futures hours are not asserted (cmegroup.com 403s this runner). Impact low, symbols [] -- a recommended early close moves nothing by itself; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
